title: Audit current R437 whole-word translation under retained physical contracts
body:
## Current-source contribution

Extends Nick Petalas's [PR #2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989) compiler-correspondence audit to the complete current R437/OQ4 event skeleton at [PR #3647](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3647) head a24f9ff95c12fd0b6792e3f710569237efd72db2. New package: `research/r437-whole-word-refinement`; no shared-code or selected-frontier changes.

- Actual retained Driver versus actual compiler/dispatcher: 288 calls, 903,456 residual sites, 7,035,840 ordered local/family XOR input-output triples, 29 global checkpoints and 12,336,607 emitted symbolic macros, at one formal low label. All arbitrary initial family contents remain symbolic. Each disposal and final staged/private cleanup is checked.
- Five semantic mutants reject, including destructive clone, lost private output, stale scatter, omitted private disposal and reversed XOR roles. Tiny two-low tests cover both mode0 and mode1.
- The unchanged `Machine.run` loop is exercised under explicit recursive-cut contract actions at depths 0,1,2,17. This adds loop-composition coverage; it does not execute physical CALL/RETURN.
- The conditional ordering theorem and omitted-owner admission guard are **credited restatements of [PR #2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989)**, not new discoveries. The useful delta is current R437/OQ4 whole-source coverage beyond its eight reduced GL2(F3) words.

## Qualification

This is a differential source-reuse check and a conditional theorem adaptation, not an independent numerical implementation. The compiler's append-only list is streamed in the checker to bound memory; branches and emitted operations are unchanged. Packet operations and residuals are opaque expression constructors. One formal low does not enumerate GL64; abstract good-block residual symbols do not test real good/fallback bodies. Primitive algebra, high fields, full production volume, source/stock/history, physical parking, time/visited-space, precision and ordinary/native/router premises remain open. No supplier admission or new kappa.

The paired operational-semantics/separation-relation and algebraic-expression approach isolates exactly this composition layer. The sibling transport/resource lanes remain separate contributions, not automatically admitted dependencies.

## Validation and pins

Canonical main and priority revision 6: 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90. Both retained R437 files match their exact upstream a24f9ff Git blobs, also retained through [PR #3936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3936). PR[3967](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967) CI was checked PASS before this round. Full local symbolic generation: CPython 3.12.3,234.03 seconds,208340 KiB peak RSS.

Registered replay, optimized semantic controls and actual Git-free quick export pass. The export run is deliberately the bounded quick scope. Changed compiler/template, missing word and symlinked dispatcher controls reject. Reproduce:

`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-whole-word-refinement`

SOURCES/TASK/VERIFY retain exact provenance, scope and commands. No historical full replay, Lean or Docker was run. Hosted CI is reported separately from local success.

## Coordination and credit

Explicit user assignment refines `independent-moment`; team claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967#issuecomment-6262146714. Live overlap found [PR #3967](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967)/[PR #3950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3950)/[PR #3936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3936)/[PR #3724](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3724)/[PR #3690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3690); the team then found and read canonical [PR #2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989), and narrowed the novelty claim accordingly. Search coverage is partial, not a novelty certificate.

Nick Petalas/[PR #2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989); Jose Manuel/[PR #2809](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2809)/[PR #2195](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2195) and numerical/ordinary lineage; David Arias/[PR #2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753); ywz65 parking/staging; ai-nanachi R437/OQ4; zxv/[PR #3690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3690); Ali Romman/[PR #1043](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1043) and retained helper/native/compiler/owner/outer contributors. Chris R/Clear1nsight's [PR #3936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3936)/[PR #3950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3950)/[PR #3967](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967) source/stream/return audits are predecessor context. New source audit, adaptation and packaging by Chris R with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Full notices and attribution are in the package.

Open next questions: independently admit actual current chart separation; prove complete residual and recursive-cut contracts; attach the complete physical cost and visited-cell invoice without omitting the rest of the rank 26 child or double-counting its internal rank 7 COPY.

Publication head `a693da700af272252d701b36614922fd838efdd2` passes exact 26-file package/input byte and canonical source-history verification plus whitespace checks. All three registered commands passed. Retained notice and input bytes preserve their original line endings. The separate current chart certificate is now public in PR #[3980](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3980); it remains subject to its stated scope and review.
